pages.title: Doll Commander
pages.text: The Seven-Colored Doll Glove lets you command all of your dolls from a distance. Hold the selection key to open its mode wheel, then use the glove to give an order. A selected target is highlighted in the mode's color.

$(bold)Summon / Recall$()$(br)Summons all stored dolls, or recalls all active dolls.$(br)$(bold)Heal Mark$()$(br)Marks the creature you are looking at so your dolls will heal it. Use again to clear the mark.$(br)$(bold)Volley$()$(br)Commands every armed doll to fire once, one after another.$(br)$(bold)Super Attack$()$(br)Commands one random doll to use its super attack.

$(bold)Suicide$()$(br)Commands one random doll to rush the enemy and detonate.$(br)$(bold)Stop$()$(br)Stops all summoned dolls.$(br)$(bold)Edit Loadout$()$(br)Opens the loadout of the doll you are looking at, even when it is too far away to reach normally.
